item.title: Version 0.7.155
item.description:
Pollen Release Notes

0.7.154

  • Added: Focus mode. Expand a pane to fit the app window. Double click pane border or press CMD+SHIFT+Enter to toggle.
  • Added: CMD+Drag an image to drop it into a website, another app, or your desktop.
  • Added: Pane Shadows.
  • Added: Hand cursor when right click dragging canvas.
  • Added: Grid snapping. Hold CMD to override.
  • Added: Two new ways to zoom: Click and hold mouse wheel and drag to zoom in or out. OR right click and hold on canvas and drag to zoom in or out.
  • Fixed: Icons in the pane navigation buttons getting stretched after zooming out.
  • Fixed: Overlapping borders.
  • Changed: Color of pane title bars on light mode.
  • Added: FPS graph. Temporary beta feature.

0.7.118

  • Changed file extension to .pollen
  • Added: Middle-click + drag to zoom in/out.
  • Upgraded: z-order stacking and layering.
  • Backend: worked on placement engine and transform subsystem to move stuff around.
  • Improved Command key zoom behavior.
  • Many other tiny tweaks, bug fixes and code scaffolding for future features.

0.7.104

  • Fixed: an issue where your panes would be gone on app restart.
  • Added: SVG support.
  • Added: Right click actions to suspend/wake panes.
  • Update: Tweaks to onboarding flow.

0.7.96

  • Initial alpha release.
  • Thank you for trying Pollen.
  • Send any feedback to sashavsosin@gmail.com.
